name: Forretress
flavorText: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.

levelUp.name: Toxic Spikes
levelUp.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the foe’s feet. They poison foes that switch into battle.

levelUp.name: Tackle
levelUp.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the foe with its whole body.

levelUp.name: Protect
levelUp.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

levelUp.name: Selfdestruct
levelUp.description: The user blows up to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

levelUp.name: Bug Bite
levelUp.description: The user bites the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

levelUp.name: Take Down
levelUp.description: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the foe. It also damages the user a little.

levelUp.name: Rapid Spin
levelUp.description: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, Leech Seed, and Spikes.

levelUp.name: Bide
levelUp.description: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.

levelUp.name: Sand Tomb
levelUp.description: The user traps the foe inside a harshly raging sandstorm for two to five turns.

levelUp.name: Natural Gift
levelUp.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

levelUp.name: Spikes
levelUp.description: The user lays a trap of spikes at the foe’s feet. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

levelUp.name: Mirror Shot
levelUp.description: The user looses a flash of energy from its polished body. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

levelUp.name: Payback
levelUp.description: If the user can use this attack after the foe attacks, its power is doubled.

levelUp.name: Explosion
levelUp.description: The user explodes to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

levelUp.name: Iron Defense
levelUp.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

levelUp.name: Gyro Ball
levelUp.description: The user tackles the foe with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

levelUp.name: Double-Edge
levelUp.description: A reckless, life- risking tackle. It also damages the user by a fairly large amount, however.

levelUp.name: Magnet Rise
levelUp.description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

levelUp.name: Zap Cannon
levelUp.description: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

tmHm.name: Toxic
tmHm.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

tmHm.name: Hidden Power
tmHm.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

tmHm.name: Sunny Day
tmHm.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

tmHm.name: Hyper Beam
tmHm.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

tmHm.name: Light Screen
tmHm.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

tmHm.name: Protect
tmHm.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Giga Drain
tmHm.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

tmHm.name: Frustration
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: SolarBeam
tmHm.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

tmHm.name: Earthquake
tmHm.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

tmHm.name: Return
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: Dig
tmHm.description: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

tmHm.name: Double Team
tmHm.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

tmHm.name: Reflect
tmHm.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

tmHm.name: Sandstorm
tmHm.description: A five-turn sand- storm is summoned to hurt all combatant types except Rock,  Ground, and Steel.

tmHm.name: Rock Tomb
tmHm.description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Speed by preventing its movement.

tmHm.name: Facade
tmHm.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

tmHm.name: Secret Power
tmHm.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

tmHm.name: Rest
tmHm.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

tmHm.name: Attract
tmHm.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

tmHm.name: Endure
tmHm.description: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Explosion
tmHm.description: The user explodes to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

tmHm.name: Payback
tmHm.description: If the user can use this attack after the foe attacks, its power is doubled.

tmHm.name: Giga Impact
tmHm.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

tmHm.name: Rock Polish
tmHm.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

tmHm.name: Gyro Ball
tmHm.description: The user tackles the foe with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

tmHm.name: Stealth Rock
tmHm.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

tmHm.name: Captivate
tmHm.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

tmHm.name: Rock Slide
tmHm.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also make the target flinch.

tmHm.name: Sleep Talk
tmHm.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

tmHm.name: Natural Gift
tmHm.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

tmHm.name: Swagger
tmHm.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

tmHm.name: Substitute
tmHm.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

tmHm.name: Flash Cannon
tmHm.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

tmHm.name: Strength
tmHm.description: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

tmHm.name: Rock Smash
tmHm.description: The user slugs the foe with a shattering punch. It can also smash cracked boulders.

tutor.name: Rollout
tutor.description: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

tutor.name: Snore
tutor.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Signal Beam
tutor.description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

tutor.name: Iron Defense
tutor.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

tutor.name: Magnet Rise
tutor.description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
